module.name: COMP
module.descriptionCn:
声音基于传奇的Ross™ Compressor*压缩效果器音色。这是吉他压缩效果器的鼻祖，是它把吉他压缩效果带入大众并成为日后不可或缺的重要元素，它拥有十分自然圆润的压缩效果，能够有效增强吉他的延音。
 
Sustain：调节压缩量
Volume：调节效果输出音量

Based on the legendary Ross™ Compressor*. This is the originator of the guitar compression effect. It brings the guitar compression effect to the public and becomes an important element in the future. It has a very natural and mellow compression effect.  
                             
Sustain: Controls the compression amount
Volume: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.

module.name: COMP4
module.descriptionCn:
声音基于著名的Keeley® compressor*压缩效果器音色一款发烧级压缩效果器。分明的层次感，精确适量的高频让你的吉他听起来更清亮。  
                              
Sustain：调节效果的压缩量
Volume：调节效果的输出音量
Attack：调节压缩效果器多久开始处理声音信号 Clipping：调节输入灵敏度

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
module.descriptionEn:
Based on the Keeley ® C4 4-knob compressor*. A recording studio - level compression effect.Clear sense of hierarchy, the right amount of high frequency makes your guitar sound brighter. 
          
Sustain: Controls the compression amount
Attack: Controls how soon the compressor starts to process the signal 
Volume: Controls the effect output 
Clipping: Controls the input sensitivity 

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
module.summaryCn: 基于著名的Keeley® compressor*压缩效果器。

module.name: Micro Boost
module.descriptionCn:
基于MXR® M133 Micro Amp*经典激励单块建模。它有着最大20dB的增益量，可以在有效提升输出信号幅度的同时不改变原始音色风味。
                            
 Gain：调节增益量/输出音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
module.descriptionEn:
Based on the legendary MXR® M133 Micro Amp2 pedal. Providing up to 20dB of gain, the Micro Boost elevates your amp sound without changing its tonal character. 
        
Gain: Controls the gain amount

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
module.summaryCn: 基于MXR® M133 Micro Amp*激励单块。
module.summaryEn: Based on MXR® M133 Micro Amp*pedal.

module.name: B-Boost
module.descriptionCn:
任何吉他手都可以从Xotic®BB Preamp*过载效果器中受益。 它可以很好地产生厚重和奶油般的过载音色，并具有出色的延音效果，提供高达30dB的激励效果。
                                
Gain：控制效果增益量
Volume：调节输出音量
Bass：调节低频
Treble：调节高频

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
module.descriptionEn:
Any guitarist can benefit from the Xotic® BB Preamp* overdrive pedal. The pedal works equally well for getting thick and creamy overdrive tones with great sustain as it does for pushing the clean front end of an already driven amp with up to 30dB of boost.  
                  
Gain: Controls the distortion amount 
Volume: Controls the effect output 
Bass/Treble: 2-band EQ that controls the effect tone

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
module.summaryEn: Based on Xotic® BB Preamp* pedal.

module.name: 14 Boost
module.descriptionCn:
声音基于著名的Fortin®Grind*，提供超纯净的20dB激励效果，超低的噪音可以保存全部的音色细节。

Gain：控制效果增益量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
module.descriptionEn:
Based famous on Fortin®Grind*. It gives you up to +20dB of boost that will tighten up and add aggression to any tube or solid-state amplifier. The GRIND’s surprising low noise floor and high input Z lets every nuance of  instrument character come through unaltered.  
                     
Gain: Controls the gain amount

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.

module.name: Boost
module.descriptionCn:
声音基于著名的Xotic®EP Booster*激励效果器音色。提供+20dB的纯净激励提升，结实的低频，明亮的高频，使清音更加悦耳。

Gain：控制效果增益量       
+3dB：选择最小增益是0dB还是+3dB
Bright：打开以增加额外的高频，关闭以保持平直频响


*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
module.descriptionEn:
Based on famous Xotic® EP Booster* pedal. Provides +20dB of pure stimulation lift, strong low frequency, bright high frequency, making clear sound more pleasant.

Gain: Controls the gain amount       
+3dB: Selects the minimum boost amount from 0dB (off) to +3dB (on)
Bright: Selects the sound character from vintage (Bright off) to flat (Bright on)

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
module.summaryCn: 基于的Xotic®EP Booster*激励效果器。
module.summaryEn: Based on Xotic® EP Booster* pedal.                                              Volume: Controls the effect output/boost amount

module.name: OD 9
module.descriptionCn:
Ibanez® Tube Screamer®*是当今许多顶级吉他手使用的透明过载音调的代名词。 TS9踏板可增强吉他信号，足以驱动您的放大器的前置放大器级，从而使音色听起来自然自然，纯净超速运转和清晰的节奏。
           
Gain：控制效果增益量
Tone：调节音色明亮度
Volume：调节效果音量

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
module.descriptionEn:
The Ibanez® Tube Screamer®* is synonymous with the transparent overdrive tone used by many of today's top guitarists. The TS9 pedal boosts the guitar signal enough to drive the preamp stage of your amp, giving a very natural-sounding and pure overdrive and crisp rhythm crunch.  
                      
Gain: Controls the overdrive amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone 
Volume: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
module.summaryCn: 基于Ibanez® TS-9 Tube Screamer®过载效果器。
module.summaryEn: Based on Ibanez® TS-9 Tube Screamer® overdrive pedal.

module.name: Yellow OD
module.descriptionCn:
1977年问世的它是一个经典的过载效果器。他的声音并不特别，但是很快成为了艺术家心中标准的过载音色。它的特点是一个不对称的电路，其中波形的正负半部分不均匀地失真。因此即使增加了失真，声音仍然接近原音。
                             
Gain：控制效果增益量
Volume：调节效果音量
module.descriptionEn:
Artist of the 70's was mostly using a fuzz distortion sound and the overdrive produced by it was not typical. It was however soon accepted as the new standard of guitar sound. It features an asymmetric circuit where the positive and negative halves of the waveform isn't distorted equally. The sound is therefore still close to the original even though distortion have been added. 
                
Gain: Controls the overdrive amount
Volume: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
module.summaryCn: 基于经典黄色双旋钮过载效果器。
module.summaryEn: Based on a classic yellow 2-knob overdrive pedal.

module.name: Penesas
module.descriptionCn:
基于Klon® Centaur*过载效果器，也就是在发烧友当中广为人知的“人马过载”。它的音色应该不需要过多介绍了：过载界的试金石。另外，将Gain拧到最小，这个效果和原版⼀样可以当Clean Boost使用。
 
Gain：调节效果增益
Tone：调节音色明亮度
Volume：调节效果输出⾳量


*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
module.descriptionEn:
Based on the legendary Klon® Centaur*, this overdrive model gives you an authentic amp-in-a-box feel with full, rich sound character that is not harsh or boomy at all. Turn Gain knob to minimum you get a superb clean boost.
 
Gain: Controls the gain amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Volume: Controls the effect output

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.

module.name: Super OD
module.descriptionCn:
独有的不对称过载效果电路，给传统的吉他音色加入了温暖悦耳的过载效果。

Gain：控制效果增益量
Tone：调节音色明亮度
Volume：调节效果音量
module.descriptionEn:
The unique asymmetric overdrive effect circuit adds warm and pleasant overdrive effect to the traditional guitar timbre. 

Gain: Controls the overdrive amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Volume: Controls the effect output
module.summaryCn: 基于经典黄色三旋钮过载效果器。
module.summaryEn: Based on a classic yellow 3-knob overdrive pedal.

module.name: Blues OD
module.descriptionCn:
不论是温暖与自然的过载效果，或是全开的失真效果，它都能够让您的吉他发挥到最大表现力，音色的控制非常容易，并且可以呈现出您个人演奏风格的细微变化。

Gain：控制效果增益量
Tone：调节音色明亮度
Volume：调节效果音量
module.descriptionEn:
Whether it's warm and natural overdrive or full open distortion, it gives your guitar the most expression, makes it easy to control the tone, and allows for subtle variations in your personal playing style.  
                          
Gain: Controls the distortion amount
Tone: Controls the effect tone
Volume: Controls the effect output
module.summaryCn: 基于经典蓝色三旋钮过载效果器。
module.summaryEn: Based on a classic blue 3-knob overdrive pedal.

module.name: T-Wah
module.descriptionCn:
通过演奏力度控制哇音音色。具有宽广调节范围的包络滤波器（Touch Wah）效果，极高的敏锐度，能够快速的捕捉你的弹奏，随着演奏⼒度的强弱而变化；提供吉他模式和贝斯模式两种可选。
                                 
Sense：调节灵敏度，参数值越高灵敏度越高
Range：调节哇音滤波器中心频率
Q：调节哇音滤波器Q值
Mix：调节原声与效果音的混合比
Mode：选择用于吉他（Guitar）还是用于贝斯（Bass）
module.descriptionEn:
Control the wah sound by playing intensity.A wide range envelope filter (a.k.a. touch wah) designed for guitarists and bassists  that is touch-sensitive and flexible. 

Sens: Controls the effect sensitivity
Range: Controls the frequency range of the filter
Q: Controls the sharpness of the filter
Mix: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio
Mode: Selects from two modes: Guitar/Bass

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
module.summaryCn: 通过演奏力度控制的哇音音色。
module.summaryEn: Control the wah sound by playing intensity.

module.name: A-WAH
module.descriptionCn:
通过设定频率使哇音有规律地进行工作。提供多样的自动哇音（Auto Wah）效果，吉他和贝斯都可以使用。
                            
Depth：控制效果深度
Rate：控制效果速度
Volume：控制效果音量
Low/High：控制效果低频/高频频点
Q：调节滤波器Q值
Sync：打点定速同步开关
module.descriptionEn:
Set the rate to make the wah pedal work regularly. Providing a variable auto wah effect for both guitars and basses. 
                    
Depth: Controls the effect depth
Rate: Controls the effect speed
Volume: Controls the output level
Low: Controls the bottom point of center frequency (low freq)
High: Controls the top point of center frequency (high freq)
Q: Controls the sharpness of the filter
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off

module.name: Step Filter
module.descriptionCn:
带有四个步进（Step）的自动滤波器效果，
用于创造合成器风格的音色。
                                
Step 1-4：控制滤波器每一个步进的中心频率
Rate：控制步进速度
Sync：打点定速同步开关
module.descriptionEn:
A 4-step auto filter machine for creating synth-like sounds. 
       
Step 1-4: Controls the filter center frequency of each step
Rate: Controls the sequencing speed 
Sync: Switches Tap Tempo sync on/off
module.summaryCn: 带有四个步进（Step）的自动滤波器效果。

module.name: OCTA
module.descriptionCn:
提供自然的复音八度音效果。
                                         
Low Oct：调节低八度效果音的音量
High Oct：调节高八度效果音的音量
Dry：调节干信号的音量
module.descriptionEn:
Provides polyphonic octave effect.   
               
Low Oct: Controls the volume of lower octave (1 oct down)
High Oct: Controls the volume of higher octave (1 oct up)
Dry: Controls the dry signal level
module.summaryCn: 自然的复音八度音效果。

module.name: Pitch
module.descriptionCn:
提供自然的移调效果。  
        
Hi Pitch：以半音为单位调节高音和声音高，最大+24（高2个八度）
Lo Pitch：以半音为单位调节低音和声音高，最大-24（低2个八度）
Dry：调节干信号的音量
Hi Vol：调节高音和声效果音量
Low Vol：调节低音和声效果音量
module.descriptionEn:
Polyphonic pitch shifter/harmonizer.  

Low/Hi Pitch: Controls the low/high pitch shifting range by semitones 
Dry: Controls the dry signal level
Low/Hi Vol: Controls the low/high pitch volume

module.name: P-Bend
module.descriptionCn:
提供⼀个简单有效的移调效果音色。
                          
H-Pitch:以半音为单位调节高音和声音高
L-Pitch:以半音为单位调节低音和声音高
Wet:调节和声效果音量
Dry:调节原声音量
Range:调节和声效果音高范围
module.descriptionEn:
Polyphonic pitch shifter/harmonizer. 

Low/Hi Pitch: Controls the low/high pitch shifting range by semitones 
Wet: Controls the wet signal level
Dry: Controls the dry signal level
Range: Controls the pitch range of harmony effect
module.summaryCn: 简单有效的移调效果音色。

module.name: Hammy
module.descriptionCn:
声音基于经典的Whammy®* 单音移调效果器音色。可以将该效果的Position参数分配到表情踏板上，然后移动表情踏板即可听到效果。
                              
Range：控制移调的范围
Harmony：和声模式（原声与效果音同时输出）开关
Volume：调节效果输出音量
Position：控制移调效果的变化

*文中所提到的厂商及产品名称仅用于直观说明该产品的效果与音色特性，商标名称归其公司所有。
module.descriptionEn:
Based on classic Whammy®* monophonic pitch shifter pedal. Assign the Position parameter to expression pedal, then move the pedal to get the effect. 
                           
Range: Controls the pitch shifting range
Harmony: Switches Harmony mode (dry and wet signals output simultaneously) on/off 
Volume: Controls the effect output volume
Position: Control the changes in pitch 

*The mentioned manufacturers and product names are trademarks or registered trademarks of the respective owners. The trademarks were used merely to identify the sound character of this product.
module.summaryCn: 基于Whammy®* 单音移调效果器。
module.summaryEn: Based on Whammy®* monophonic pitch shifter pedal.

module.name: Ring Mod
module.descriptionCn:
这是⼀款环形调制效果，用于制造⼀些有趣的失谐音色（比如钟声和铃声）。

Mix：控制原声与效果音的混合比例
Freq：粗调效果调制频率
Fine：以1Hz为单位精调调制频率
Tone：调节效果音色明亮度
module.descriptionEn:
A ring modulator for creating intresting inharmonic frequency spectra (like bells and chimes). 
                            
Mix: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio
Freq: Controls the overall modulation frequency
Fine: Fine tune the modulation frequency by +/- 50Hz
Tone: Controls the effect tone

module.name: Saturate
module.descriptionCn:
模拟老式磁带录音机的声音特征，为声音增加饱和度。


Saturation：调节效果饱和度（增益量）
Mix：调节效果干湿信号比
Volume：调节效果输出音量
High Cut：调节高频信号衰减量
module.descriptionEn:
Vintage tape saturation simulater providing analog warmth and natural distortion. 

Saturation: Controls the effect gain
Mix: Controls the wet/dry signal ratio
Volume: Controls the effect output volume
High Cut: Cuts the effect high frequency signal

module.name: AC Sim
module.descriptionCn:
为电吉他打造的箱琴模拟效果，原型来自经典的原声吉他模拟单块。       
          
Body：控制原声吉他模拟的箱体共振
Top：调节原声吉他的高频泛音和触弦音色
Volume：调节效果音量
Mode：选择音色模式
  STANDARD：模拟一个标准的木吉他音色
  JUMBO：模拟Jumbo型箱琴音色    
  ENHANCED：使木吉他效果拥有更多的泛音、更强的音头
  PIEZO：模拟琴桥压电拾音器音色
module.descriptionEn:
Acoustic guitar simulator designed for guitars. Its prototype comes from a classic acoustic guitar analog stompbox.  
        
Body: Controls the "body resonance" (low frequency response)
Top: Controls the upper harmonics (high frequency response)
Volume: Controls the effect output level
Mode: Selects from 4 different sound characters:
  Standard: Simulates the tonal characteristics of a standard acoustic guitar
  Jumbo: Simulates the tonal characteristics of a jumbo acoustic guitar 
  Enhanced: Simulates the tonal characteristics of an acoustic guitar with enhanced attack
  Piezo: Simulates the sound of a piezo pickup

module.name: V-Wah
module.descriptionCn:
声音基于传奇的VOX® V845* 哇音效果器音色。最早出现的哇音踏板，最初的设计目的是让经过拾音的管乐发出更有情绪表现力的“哇哇”声。幅度较小，作用在中频至高频之间。

module.name: C-Wah
module.descriptionCn:
声音基于传奇的Dunlop® CryBaby®*哇音效果器色。60年代经典的传统哇音踏板，作用在低频至中频之间，幅度适中，音色中性。
                               
Range：控制哇音滤波器中心频率
Q：调节哇音滤波器Q值
Volume：控制哇音音量
将表情踏板作为哇音使用时，请将Position参数分配到
表情踏板上，此时打开并踩踏表情踏板即可听到效果。
